uncited: **Depth Pass (Meshes):** Render the depth of all 3D meshes in the scene into an FBO.
**Back Coordinates Pass (Volume):** Render the back faces of the volume bounding box into a separate FBO.
**Ray Traversal and Composition Pass:** Render 3D objects and volume data to the screen buffer.
In the fragment shader, rays are cast towards the volume.
All outputs from previous passes are sampled as 2D textures.
It assumes access to textures generated in previous passes.
